fields.name: air_carrier_name
fields.description: Air carrier responsible for the safety-management process.

fields.name: safety_event_id
fields.description: Unique carrier safety-event identifier.

fields.name: safety_event_type
fields.description: Hazard report, incident, accident, service difficulty, audit finding, or other safety-event class.

fields.name: flight_number
fields.description: Flight number associated with the event.

fields.name: aircraft_tail_number
fields.description: Aircraft associated with the event.

fields.name: airport_code
fields.description: Airport or station associated with the event.

fields.name: incident_occurred_at
fields.description: Timestamp of the occurrence or detection.

fields.name: incident_description
fields.description: Factual description of the reported event.

fields.name: hazard_description
fields.description: Identified condition that could cause or contribute to an undesired event.

fields.name: risk_severity
fields.description: Assessed consequence severity under the approved SMS matrix.

fields.name: risk_likelihood
fields.description: Assessed likelihood under the approved SMS matrix.

fields.name: risk_acceptability
fields.description: Acceptable, acceptable with mitigation, or unacceptable risk disposition.

fields.name: immediate_action
fields.description: Immediate containment or safety action taken.

fields.name: corrective_action
fields.description: Approved corrective action or risk control.

fields.name: corrective_action_owner
fields.description: Accountable owner for the corrective action.

fields.name: corrective_action_due_date
fields.description: Target completion date for the corrective action.

fields.name: sms_assurance_status
fields.description: Monitoring and effectiveness-verification status.

fields.name: service_difficulty_reportable
fields.description: Whether Part 121 service-difficulty reporting criteria apply.

fields.name: regulator_name
fields.description: FAA, NTSB, TSA, DOT, or other reporting recipient when applicable.

fields.name: reporting_deadline
fields.description: Applicable external reporting deadline.

fields.name: regulation_citations
fields.description: Applicable current Part 5, Part 121, NTSB, or other citations.

fields.name: compliance_status
fields.description: Reporting and risk-control readiness status with gaps identified.
